title: Little Girl on Tricycle by VW Beetle, 1958 Suburbia B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic snapshot dated September 1958 showing a young girl in a patterned puff-sleeve dress joyfully pedaling her tricycle down a paved driveway. Parked beside her is a vintage Volkswagen Beetle with classic curved fenders and rear bumper guards. In the background, mid-century suburban single-family ranch-style homes line the quiet neighborhood street, epitomizing the idyllic post-war American suburban lifestyle.
